old_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a hand wearing an elegant ring. The ring features three prominent diamonds set side by side in a silver band. The hand is positioned against a neutral background, which helps to highlight the sparkle and brilliance of the gemstones. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the intricate details of the ring and the smooth texture of the skin. There are no other objects or characters present in the frame, ensuring that the viewer's attention is solely on the ring and the hand it rests upon. The lighting is soft yet sufficient to accentuate the sparkle of the diamonds, creating a serene and focused visual experience.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a hand wearing an elegant ring. The ring features a central diamond surrounded by smaller diamonds, all set in a silver band. The hand is positioned against a neutral background, which helps to highlight the sparkle and brilliance of the gemstones. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the intricate details of the ring and the smooth texture of the skin. There are no other objects or characters present in the frame, ensuring that the viewer's attention is solely on the ring and the hand it rests upon. The lighting is soft yet sufficient to accentuate the sparkle of the diamonds, creating a serene and focused visual experience.
caption: An extreme close-up frames a person's hand with fingers extended upward against a dark, out-of-focus gray background. A three-stone ring sits on the middle finger, its white-metal band holding a larger round center stone flanked by two smaller round stones in prong settings. The hand remains essentially in place, showing only small positional and rotational adjustments as the ring and finger edges shift slightly within the frame. Bright starburst specular reflections flash intermittently across the stones rather than continuously, sweeping from the right to the center, then the left, and recurring on different facets. The overall view drifts a little, consistent with minor camera or hand motion, while the dominant activity is this shifting sparkle pattern. The ring's three-stone layout and the finger it occupies stay constant, with no deformation or new object entering the scene.

prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
